incidents.name: Transit Swap
incidents.notes: Router with arbitrary-call: attacker-controlled call target/data drained user approvals.

sources.ref: onchain review (no exploit tx in this row; DeFiHackLabs src/test/2022-10/TransitSwap_exp.sol documents the attack. Incident block located by binary-searching eth_getBlockByNumber to measurement.incidentTimestamp -> bsc block 21808649, 2022-10-01T12:00:00Z). The victim 0xed1afc8c4604958c2f38a3408fa63b32e737c428 (unverified, 2820-byte runtime) was created at bsc block 11986161, 2021-10-22T06:52:16Z. It is not a proxy: disassembly shows no DELEGATECALL in the executable region - the single 0xf4 byte a naive opcode scan reports falls inside the trailing CBOR metadata blob - there is no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, and eth_getCode is byte-identical at the creation block and the incident block, so the deployment basis is exact. Its storage slot 0 holds 0xfab745c5ee6c59c09605a40464232930892ba48c (the deploying EOA) unchanged since creation; the remaining slots are an owner/flag pair and a mapping(address => bool) of authorised callers, i.e. configuration, not code. The measurement does not depend on which half of the pair is taken as the victim: the TransitSwap router DeFiHackLabs labels vulnerable, 0x8785bb8deAE13783b24D7aFE250d42eA7D7e9d72, was deployed by the same EOA two minutes later at 2021-10-22T06:54:44Z (block 11986204), giving the same ~344 day age.

incidents.name: Transit router exactInputV3Swap arbitrary pool call
incidents.notes: The Transit router's exactInputV3Swap path treats the caller-supplied pools array as trusted call targets, so the attacker pointed the first hop at its own contract and drained the router's held balances.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x00000047bB99ea4D791bb749D970DE71EE0b1A34 created 2023-08-31T06:43:50Z by 0xca2a489cb8ab1c5c56933a319ec386f44377d778, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xf7552ba0ee5bed0f306658f4a1201f421d703898; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). Loss taken from the PoC run log (173.907 BNB withdrawn); at ~USD 250/BNB in December 2023 that is roughly USD 43K. 173.9 BNB x $252.12/BNB at the incident timestamp 1703037712 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $43,845.
